modules.module_title: Operating the polishing machine and polishing the metal surface

pcs.pc_description: clean the metal surface before polishing
start with rough abrasive if the material is unfinished
ensure to choose the right wheel with the appropriate thickness for polishing
use fine smooth abrasive at subsequent stages until the desired level of finish is obtained
ensure not to use pressure in applying the abrasive to the surface
ensure the imperfections such as lines, scratches, etc. within the metal surface are removed with the rough abrasive applied at first stage
use appropriate lubricants and polishing tools as per the finish requirements
ensure to use different abrasive for every metal to be polished
repeat the process with finer polishing abrasive to every step till the visible scratches are removed and desired finish is achieved
apply lacquer to the surface to protect it from future oxidation
ensure to wear safe and protective gear such as goggles, face shield, dust mask, gloves, apron, etc. when polishing
check polished piece visually in order to detect defects such as impurities, grease, marks, uneven finish, rough edges, etc.
clean the work place and material with warm soapy water once work is complete
dry the work place with soft cloth
ensure all excess abrasives or dirt are removed
conduct regular and controlled environment cleaning for collection of metal dust
check the metal after polishing, if it matches requirement
make necessary adjustments if any
rectify and rework if any mistakes are found with respect to the design specifications and requirements

modules.module_title: Undertaking preventive maintenance of the machine

pcs.pc_description: ensure general maintenance of the machine
ensure no shut down of machines due to improper maintenance
perform regular cleaning process as prescribed by manufacturer
minimise metal loss below the prescribed limits
ensure the scratches, dents, spots, rust, etc. are removed and the surface looks clean and shiny
ensure the target number of pieces are polished
ensure the finished product is as per the requirements
ensure the output delivered is defect free and on time
